meta.name: build
meta.description: Implement a scoped software change for a customer and verify its behavior. Use for delivery work with an understood outcome, not incident response.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按明确需求改好一段代码,并验证它真的按预期运行。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一个范围明确的改动,要做完并确认它没坏。
copy.tagline_en: Ship a scoped code change and confirm it runs as expected.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have one well-defined code change to build and verify.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按任务上下文契约与方法，为客户实现一个有明确范围的软件改动，并验证其行为。它直接基于给定的上下文工作，独立使用时不需要 engagement 文件夹或初始化。
howto.when: 当交付工作的预期结果是明确的、需要实现并验证改动时使用；不用于事件响应。若被 @fde 调用，则复用其当前的上下文与范围，不重启设置或重复提问。

say.text: 按已确认的范围实现这个改动，并验证它的行为。
say.note: 它会实现并跑验证，不涉及部署。

say.text: 复用 @fde 当前的上下文和范围，直接开始实现。
say.note: 跳过重复的发现与提问。

say.text: 缺少某项能力或检查没跑，就如实告诉我。
say.note: 它会说明未执行的部分，不虚报。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude implements a scoped software change for a customer and verifies its behavior, working directly from the supplied context. Standalone work needs no engagement folder or setup.
howto.when_en: Use for delivery work with an understood outcome that needs implementing and verifying, not incident response. If called by @fde, it reuses that context and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Implement this change within the confirmed scope and verify its behavior.
say_en.note: It implements and verifies; no deployment.

say_en.text: Reuse @fde's current context and scope; start implementing.
If a capability is missing or a check didn't run, tell me honestly.
